input.query: SELECT date_trunc('week', decision_date)::DATE week_start, SUM(n_decisions) decisions, SUM(n_approved) approved, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' AND decision_date >= DATE '2026-03-02' AND decision_date < DATE '2026-04-27' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
